clips.title: The story
paras: At Windshear Mine, Venture Co. Letters carry word of the cartel's work in Stonetalon Mountains. Recovered amid explosive distractions, they give the night elf Sentinels intelligence on goblin operations.

Venture Company machines cut timber and strip-mine the ancient woodland around Windshear Crag. Alliance operatives set off covert sabotage to distract the workers and enter Windshear Mine. The letters they recover hold private messages and logistical records of the company's local work. Sentinel leaders can learn how the defilers arrange their workforce and supply lines from those records.
